message.content:
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - Overall context (from prior compaction): Build a Codex/Claude Code plugin for the "AX 인재전쟁" hackathon targeting **채널톡 (Channel Talk / 채널코퍼레이션)**, in `/Users/thk/project-catalyst/04-ax-wars-channeltalk/`. Thesis: enterprise ALF-v2 deployment is the bottleneck; field learnings don't flow back to HQ product. Plugin interviews customer frontline staff (voice) → deployment plan + product feedback.
   - **This session's explicit requests, in order:**
     1. Improve output format/quality of `deployment-brief.md` to **BCG-consultant-to-C-level report** standard: 두괄식, 핵심 메시지=첫 문장, 명사형 종결어미, 문단 마지막 문장 마침표 없음, 근거 상세+인용, jargon 각주/쉬운 말 풀이, no 전문어 나열식. New 7-section structure (Executive Summary/현황/페인포인트/도입 우선순위 스코어링 테이블/기술 고려/원가·제시가/추가 세일즈). Update interview scripts + grill-me to elicit needed data.
     2. Decision 1-A: LLM-authored (not deterministic renderer). Decision 2: costing-assumptions file. Rename `handoff` skill (name collision).
     3. Remove footnotes ([^tag]) — hard to render; explain jargon inline instead. Remove 가운데점 (·) — use commas or numbering. Bullets start with `[라벨]`. Shorter sentences.
     4. Section 4 table: map each automation target to which Channel Talk product/agent (알프 지식/규칙/태스크).
     5. Section 5: per-priority-agent tech considerations, incl. **knowledge base readiness** (docs exist?, FAQ format, 표준 문구, cleanup effort → 알프 지식 도입 난이도). Connect section 4↔5.
     6. Reposition "PRD" doc → **본진 프로덕트팀용 "고객 페인포인트/니즈 + 제품 개발 시 고려사항" 문서** (remove PRD concept entirely). Explained who/why, then plan.
     7. Rename headings: "고객 페인"→"고객 페인포인트", "1. 한눈에"→"1. Summary", "4"→"제품 개발 간 고려사항", "5"→"확인 및 추적 필요사항".
     8. ElevenLabs: make voice faster + change voice (chose HJ Korean female).
     9. Rename plugin (Channel Talk feel) → chose **alfboard**; skills → **interview** + **report** (start kept then removed); color → **옅은 보라(라벤더)**.
     10. Startup banner/intro that shows at session start (like Claude Code's mascot+description). Went through MANY iterations; user found ASCII art crude ("개구리다", "너 그림 너무 못 그리네").
     11. **FINAL banner decision: remove ALL start-screen scripts/hooks/banner; delete `start` skill; revert to just interview + report skills.**
     12. Update README.md; set up plugin so slash commands work locally.
     13. Rename tagline "채널톡 엔터프라이즈 배포 discovery" → **"채널톡 알프 도입 준비 자동화"** (user found "배포 discovery" unclear).
     14. **UNRESOLVED:** "여전히 플러그인 목록에 안 뜨는데? 왜 이런 문제가 반복되는거야?" — plugin/skills still not appearing in plugin list after `/reload-plugins`.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Channel Talk / 알프(ALF): AI 상담 에이전트. **알프 v2 = 지식(Knowledge) + 규칙(Rules) + 태스크(Tasks)** 3 기능. 미트(Meet)=AI Phone. Channel Blue `#6157EA`. 완전 자본잠식, 일본 25% 매출.
   - Report writing principles (enforced in plugin references): 두괄식, 명사형 종결, no trailing period, no footnotes (inline jargon), no 가운데점(·), `[라벨]` bullets, short sentences, evidence-based.
   - LLM-authored deliverables via SKILL.md rubrics (not deterministic Python). Deterministic code = only validate_discovery.py.
   - integration tier: no_integration/workflow/system_task = 해결률 상한.
   - product_gaps tags: action_task, reask_context, knowledge_authoring, voc_distribution, metric_redefine, handoff_quality, multilingual, small_team. Added product_surface field.
   - Claude Code plugins: `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, skills auto-loaded from `skills:"./skills/"`, hooks from `hooks/hooks.json`, SessionStart hook stdout→additionalContext (not shown to user). Startup ASCII logo NOT customizable. Skills invoked via `/plugin:skill`.
   - Codex plugins: `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` with `interface` block (displayName, shortDescription, longDescription, defaultPrompt, brandColor). Marketplace-based install.
   - Local marketplace: `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` at repo root with `plugins:[{name, source:"./alfboard", description}]`. `claude plugin marketplace add <path>` + `claude plugin install <name>@<marketplace>`.
   - ElevenLabs Agents: agent_id `agent_8701kwtk1qf5f1aavt07tykez7qg`. TTS `speed` (0.7-1.2), `voice_id`. HJ voice `eI3jlA17XYDwAIY4lo0y`. Add shared voice: `POST /v1/voices/add/{owner}/{voice_id}`.
   - Korean double-width (east_asian_width W/F=2) breaks ASCII box alignment; ambiguous(A) chars (→①▸←) render 2 in Korean-locale terminals.

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - **Plugin folder renamed `onramp/` → `alfboard/`** (via `git mv`); skills `intake→interview`, `brief→report` (via `git mv`); bulk text replace via `perl -i -pe 's/onramp/alfboard/g; s/Onramp/Alfboard/g; s/ONRAMP/ALFBOARD/g; s/intake/interview/g; s/(?<!deployment-)brief/report/g; s/Brief/Report/g; s/민트/보라/g'` (used while-read loop because zsh doesn't word-split unquoted scalars; `deployment-brief` preserved via negative lookbehind).
   - `alfboard/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` — name "alfboard", skills "./skills/", description now "Alfboard — 채널톡 알프 도입 준비 자동화. …'배포 계획서'…'제품 인풋 문서'(본진 프로덕트팀 피드백…)…". No hooks field.
   - `alfboard/.codex-plugin/plugin.json` — created for Codex compat; interface{displayName Alfboard, shortDescription "채널톡 알프 도입 준비 자동화 — 음성 인터뷰로 배포 계획서와 제품 피드백을 생성", longDescription, defaultPrompt[2], brandColor "#6157EA"}. keywords deduped.
   - `alfboard/skills/interview/` — SKILL.md (name: interview; title "# Interview — 도입 준비 음성 인터뷰 (①단계)"), README.md ("# 🎙️ Interview — 도입 준비 음성 인터뷰"), prompt/interviewer-system-prompt.md (4 role flows, grill-me 2-followup cap, elicits 정량 현황/IT 여력/지식 준비도/세일즈), references/discovery-spec.md (schema: added context.org, inquiry_types[].avg_leadtime, it_capacity, knowledge_readiness {docs_exist,faq_count_est,faq_format,standard_templates,doc_scope,quality_gap,authoring_effort}, product_gaps[].product_surface), scripts/validate_discovery.py (warnings for org/leadtime/it_capacity/faq_format), scripts/setup_agent.py (added `--speed` flag → tts.speed), .env (gitignored, real key), tests/test_discovery.py + test_transcript.py.
   - `alfboard/skills/report/` — SKILL.md (name: report; LLM-authors both docs; title "# Report — discovery → 보고서"; "도입 준비 파이프라인의 ②단계"), references/deployment-brief-format.md (6+ principles, 7 sections, 알프 지식/규칙/태스크 mapping, 도입 난이도 per-agent variables), references/product-input-format.md (5 sections: Summary/고객 페인포인트·니즈 지도/상세/제품 개발 간 고려사항/확인·추적, product surface vocab+tag mapping), references/costing-assumptions.md (SE 일 40만, 개발 50만, tier별 소요, 마진 35%). **build_reports.py and tests/test_reports.py DELETED** (render_prd retired).
   - `alfboard/samples/무브온/` — deployment-discovery.json (enriched: org/R&R/leadtime/it_capacity/knowledge_readiness/product_surface), transcripts/{cs_lead,exec,agent,it}.md (augmented), deployment-brief.md (new format exemplar, 가운데점 0, 각주 0), product-input.md (renamed from .prd.md; new format, Summary/고객 페인포인트·니즈 지도 etc.).
   - **DELETED this session:** `alfboard/skills/start/` (start skill), `alfboard/hooks/hooks.json` (SessionStart), `alfboard/assets/banner.py` (all banner iterations).
   - `alfboard/README.md` — updated: title "# Alfboard — 채널톡 알프 도입 준비 자동화 Plug-in" (user/linter added "Plug-in"), added "## 설치 & 사용 (슬래시)" section with install commands + `/alfboard:interview`, `/alfboard:report`. NOTE: a linter mangled some markdown (wrapped `[links](url)` and `**/alfboard:interview**` in backticks — technically broken but I was instructed NOT to revert linter changes).
   - `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` (at 04 root) — created: `{name:"alfboard-dev", owner, plugins:[{name:"alfboard", source:"./alfboard", description:"채널톡 알프 도입 준비 자동화 — 고객 음성 인터뷰(interview)로 배포 계획서와 제품 피드백 문서(report)를 자동 생성"}]}`.
   - `04_report-format-redesign.md` — plan/record doc (has product-input reposition section).

4. Errors and fixes:
   - perl bulk-replace silently failed first time (zsh doesn't word-split unquoted `$files` scalar → passed whole multiline string as one filename). Fixed with `while IFS= read -r f; do perl ... "$f"; done` loop.
   - `git rm banner.py` failed ("pathspec didn't match") — banner.py was untracked (created this session, never committed). Fixed with plain `rm -f`.
   - ASCII box misalignment (68 vs 69 width): caused by ambiguous-width symbols + one 65-char content line. Fixed by ASCII-ifying (→→->, ①→1), ▸→>, removing ← ) and bumping CW 64→66.
   - AskUserQuestion first call rejected (invalid JSON escape `\48b`). Fixed by re-calling with clean structured params.
   - **User feedback (critical):** ASCII art repeatedly rejected as crude/ugly ("개구리다 이건 절대 안 되겠는데", "진짜 너 그림 너무 못 그리네"). Colored ANSI didn't render in their client (showed raw `[38;2;…m` codes). "bash 창 눌러야 뜨는" = start skill ran banner via Bash (collapsed tool call). Final resolution: user demanded removal of ALL banner/start/hooks → done.

5. Problem Solving:
   - Reconciled LLM-authored narrative reports with deterministic contract (validate_discovery.py gate stays; prose is LLM-authored per format references).
   - Repositioned second deliverable from "PRD" to "product input / 제품 피드백 문서" (deployment person surfaces signals + build considerations, NOT feature specs).
   - Voice: applied speed 1.1 + HJ Korean voice live via ElevenLabs API (verified with TTS test 128KB mp3).
   - Explained "배포 discovery" = pre-deployment investigation phase; renamed to "도입 준비 자동화".
   - **ONGOING/UNRESOLVED:** User says plugin skills still don't appear in plugin list after `/reload-plugins`. Note: the `/reload-plugins` output said "Reloaded: 10 plugins · 1 skill · …" (only "1 skill" — suspicious), yet the Skill tool list DOES show `alfboard:interview` and `alfboard:report`. Plugin verified installed (`alfboard@alfboard-dev`, scope: user, enabled, Skills(2), Hooks(0)) via `claude plugin details`.

6. All user messages:
   - "@…/deployment-brief.md 일단 산출물 중 하나인 deployment-brief 부터 어떤 포맷 및 원칙으로 작성해야할지를 한 번 이야기해보자. …최고경영자, C레벨에 보고하는 보고서… 1) 두괄식 2) 핵심 메시지 첫 문장 3) 명사형 종결어미 3) 문단 마지막 문장 '.' 안 찍기 4) 근거 상세 5) jargon 각주… 보고서 구성… 1.제목 2.Executive Summary 3.현황파악→페인포인트→에이전트 우선순위 테이블→기술 고려사항→도입 원가/제시가→추가 세일즈… 7) 스크립트 4개 그룹 업데이트… grill-me 꼬리질문… 두 번 물어도 두루뭉실하면 그만."
   - "결정 1 A로 해주고, 결정 2는 너가 이야기한대로 해줘. 다만, handoff 스킬 이름만 바꿔줘 원래 있던 스킬명이랑 겹쳐서."
   - "계속 진행해줘"
   - "1. 응 그렇게 해주고 [footnote removal] 2. 가운데점 쓰지 말고 ',' 쓰거나 넘버링 3. 불렛 [] 안에 라벨 [조직 및 R&R]… 가독성 높이기… 만연체 X 적절한 길이로 끊기"
   - "다 좋은데 4번 항목… 자동화 대상별로 어떤 에이전트(채널톡 프로덕트가 알프만 있는 건 아니라고 알고 있음) 붙일지가 테이블에 맵핑되면 좋을 것 같은데 이거 반영해줘"

   - "보일러 플레이트가 근데 무슨 뜻이야?"
   - "응 그대로 구현해줘"
   - "이어서 PRD 문서도 작업해보자… PRD 문서가 사실 내가 정확히 누가 이 PRD 문서가 필요하고, 어떤 목적으로… 플러그인에서 그건 아직 잘 이해를 못하고 있어서, 그 부분에 대해서 먼저 설명… 배포계획서 어떻게 수정했는지를 기준으로 PRD 문서 어떻게 바꾸면 좋을지… 플랜을 짜서 나한테 보여주면"
